name: Murray Plastics
old_description: We are a top-tier custom plastic injection molding company, renowned for our precision, innovation, and quality. Our state-of-the-art facility and experienced experts enable us to create intricate plastic components using advanced molding techniques, consistently delivering excellence to meet diverse client needs.
about:
Murray Plastics is based in Gainesville, Georgia, where it operates as a founder-led United States manufacturer of custom plastic injection molded components. The company does not disclose its founding year or the identities of its founders in its public materials.

Its core capabilities include custom plastic injection molding, mold building, and design and engineering support. The firm describes its facility as state-of-the-art and staffed by experienced experts, though it does not provide figures for plant size, employee count, annual volume, or part-number range.

The company markets its services broadly to customers seeking American-made plastic parts, but it does not name specific industries, end markets, or reference customers on its website.

Murray Plastics differentiates itself by highlighting its founder-led ownership, which it says enables personable, down-to-earth service and direct collaboration with clients. The team offers design insight, new ideas for product improvement, and assistance with material selection, including eco-friendly plastic options, positioning the business as a competitive domestic source for injection molded parts.
